title: Screenshot manifest (v0.2.0)
description: Written by scripts/ingest-screens.mjs. Lists the screenshots of one review with their verified format, pixel size and SHA-256. File paths are relative to the manifest, use forward slashes and may not leave its directory. Pixel sizes and hashes come from the tool, never from the model.

provenance.description: synthetic: generated for this project. permission_cleared: the owner has allowed use and the image holds no personal or confidential data.

order.description: 1-based position in the journey. Unique and contiguous.

file.description: Relative path, forward slashes, no '..', extension .png, .jpg or .jpeg.

format.description: Detected from file content, not the extension.
